title: MINI MPC HUMPIRE
sub: The pads of MINI MPC HUMPIRE (free), recorded straight from the plugin. Tap the pads (the first 16 keys) or use your computer keyboard.
foot: You're hearing the 16 pads in 2 variations. Tap the pads or use your computer keyboard — the bottom row of keys is the pad bank. The full plugin has 64 pads and over 1,000 grooves.
